name: UGC Limited Codes
desc:
✨ Redeem UGC Codes from your favorite UGC Creators to unlock exclusive virtual items! 

💫 Are you a UGC Creator yourself? You can use this tool to easily create & distribute codes for your UGC Limiteds! 
👉 You can also set max uses caps on each code, and see real-time usage statistics for each of your codes.

NOTICE: Not all codes that you redeem here will be free items! Be sure to check the price of the item before confirming your purchase.
